aiNarrative.title: Explain the battery health forecast
aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain which charging habits and risk factors drive your deterministic battery-health forecast. The narrator never changes the forecast — it grounds every sentence in the same numbers the chart below renders.

insight.highSpreadDesc: Cell imbalance is significant. Consider a full charge to 100% to allow BMS balancing, then discharge to 90%.
insight.watchSpreadDesc: Cell balance is slightly off. Periodic full charges can help the BMS equalize cells.
insight.balancedDesc: Voltage spread is within healthy range. Battery cells are operating normally.
insight.highTempDesc: Avoid fast charging in extreme temperatures. Allow the battery to precondition before supercharging.
insight.watchTempDesc: Some temperature variation is normal. Monitor during fast charging sessions.
insight.goodTempDesc: Module temperatures are consistent. Thermal management system is performing well.
insight.criticalCellsDesc: {{count}} cell(s) show significant deviation. Consider scheduling a service appointment.
insight.healthyDesc: No critical cells detected. Continue current charging habits for long-term health.

degradation.title: Battery degradation
degradation.needMore: Need more data points to generate prediction (minimum 3 snapshots required)
degradation.noRange: Range data will appear once history is available.
degradation.noRiskData: Risk data will appear once charging history is available.
degradation.noRecommendations: Recommendations will appear based on your usage patterns.
degradation.stressLow: Your charging habits are optimal for battery longevity.
degradation.stressMedium: Consider reducing fast charging frequency and avoiding full charges when possible.
degradation.stressHigh: High stress detected. Reducing fast charges and deep discharges can improve battery lifespan.
degradation.noHistoryDescription: Capacity estimates appear after enough charging, range, and odometer snapshots have accumulated.

health.missingMeasurement: Capacity measurements are not available yet; battery health cannot be assessed.

insight.excellentDesc: Battery health is {{soh}}/100 — performing above average.
insight.goodDesc: Battery health is {{soh}}/100 — normal degradation for age.
insight.concernDesc: Battery health dropped to {{soh}}/100 — consider service check.
insight.highFastChargeDesc: {{pct}} of sessions are fast-charging. Mix in slow charging for longevity.
insight.goodHabitsDesc: Most charges are slow/AC — ideal for battery longevity.
insight.deepDischargeDesc: {{count}} recent sessions started below 10%. Avoid deep discharges when possible.
insight.highSuperchargerDesc: {{count}} Supercharger sessions. Occasional slow charging helps battery health.
insight.lowDegDesc: {{rate}}% per year — well below industry average of 3–5%.

tip.reduceFast: Reduce fast charging frequency to slow degradation.
tip.avoid100: Avoid charging to 100% regularly — keep the limit at 80–90%.
tip.avoidDeep: Try to avoid deep discharges below 20%.
tip.aboveAvg: Your degradation rate is above average — review charging habits.
tip.great: Your battery health looks great — keep up the good habits!
tip.needMeasurements: Keep monitoring as capacity measurements arrive; battery health cannot be assessed yet.
